description: Free decision step. Call this FIRST, before you search the web, reason a check out yourself, or pay any route. Input is one plain-language sentence about what you are about to look up or verify (for example "validate a German IBAN before a transfer" or "is 2028 a leap year"). Returns JSON with decision = "pay", "compute" or "skip". On pay it also returns method, route, url, price_usdc and a short why: you then call that url and pay the HTTP 402 yourself with x402 (USDC on Base). On compute the task is simple arithmetic you should do locally and not pay for. On skip there is no matching route; do not guess one. Read-only and free: it never pays, never calls the paid route and never returns the fact itself. An empty task returns skip.

task.description: One plain-language sentence describing what you are about to look up or verify, for example "check an invoice where net plus VAT may not equal gross". Not a route path; use describe_route for that.

name: choose_route
